import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import planner

# monkeypatch to collect stats on dp vectors
src = open('/workspace/submission/planner.py').read()
R=64
rng=random.Random(5)
starts=[0]+sorted({rng.randrange(1,1<<127) for _ in range(R-1)})
q=[rng.randrange(1,100) for _ in range(R)]
bursts=[(rng.randrange(1,1000000), sorted({rng.randrange(R) for _ in range(8)})) for _ in range(32)]
leaf,inte=planner.option_tables([3,5,7])
orig = planner.plan_version
import types
# instrument: wrap by re-running with a patched module that records vector sizes
code = src.replace("            dp[base] = vec", "            STATS.append(sum(1 for a,b in zip(vec,vec[1:]) if a!=b)+1)\n            dp[base] = vec")
mod = types.ModuleType('p2')
mod.__dict__['STATS']=[]
exec(compile(code,'p2','exec'), mod.__dict__)
t=time.time()
plans=mod.plan_version(R,starts,q,bursts,12,4,200,[3,5,7],leaf,inte)
print("time",time.time()-t)
S=mod.__dict__['STATS']
import statistics
print("vectors",len(S),"mean breakpoints",statistics.mean(S),"max",max(S),"hist",{k:S.count(k) for k in range(1,14)})
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/frontier_stats.py
